name: inhibin subunit alpha

function.text: INHA encodes inhibin alpha chain. Annotated molecular activities include cytokine activity and hormone activity. It participates in signal transduction and cell differentiation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

function.text: INHA encodes inhibin alpha chain. Based in part on similarity, inhibins/activins are involved in regulating a number of diverse functions such as hypothalamic and pituitary hormone secretion, gonadal hormone secretion, germ cell development and maturation, erythroid differentiation, insulin secretion, nerve cell survival, embryonic axial development or bone growth, depending on their subunit composition. It inhibits the secretion of FSH from the anterior pituitary gland by acting on pituitary gonadotrope cells.
